correctness.rationale: For fixed a,b>=2, summing opposite-class isolation-indicator covariances yields ab[h_m((a-1)(b-1))-h_m((a-1)b)h_m(a(b-1))], where h_m(s)=C(s,m)/C(ab,m). Exact ratio factorization has factors 1-t/((R-t)(C-t)); the t=1 factor proves negativity for 2<=m<=J, while J<m<=min(R,C) has zero joint and positive marginals and m>min(R,C) has a vanishing marginal. Thus the strict sign interval is precisely 2<=m<=ab-max(a,b); the other values vanish. Bernoulli covariance is ab*p*(1-p)^(a+b-1)>0, and with-replacement endpoints make X and Y independent. Expanding the log product for a~alpha*n,b~beta*n,m~gamma*n gives fixed-edge limit -gamma^2*exp(-gamma*(1/alpha+1/beta))/(2*alpha*beta), and Bernoulli covariance/n tends to gamma*exp(-gamma*(1/alpha+1/beta)). Independent exact edge-subset enumeration checked all m for three small rectangles; finite checks do not prove the general or limit formulas.
